39.4.name: 用 it is ... that 把要强调的圈出来

items.stem:
It was on Nov 4, 1923， that British archaeologist Howard Carter stumbled on a stone at the base of the tomb of another pharaoh(法老)in Luxor that eventually led to a sealed doorway.

"It was ... that" picks out:

opts.t: the date, as the piece the writer wants you to notice
a dummy it with no emphasis
the tomb as the only news

items.note: it was ... that 把 1923 年 11 月 4 日圈出来强调。读成普通的 it，这个日期为什么单独站出来就看不懂。
items.from: 模拟题 · 句子来自2012年专四阅读。用来练读懂，不是真题。

items.stem:
The first of these is the application of the machines, products and systems of applied knowledge that scientists and technologists develop.

This sentence only makes sense:

opts.t: as one step in a paragraph that has already said there are two aspects
as a paragraph by itself, with no sentence before it
as a title with no statement

items.note: the first of these 要靠前面那句才接得上。单独看，these 没有着落，一段话就散了。

"However" ties this sentence to:

opts.t: a previous sentence that said the opposite, the usual cliche
nothing; it is just a sound

items.note: however 是和上一句对着接。没有前面的套话，这句的转折就没处转。
